newsitem.title: CHINA: City Telecom offers 100 mln shrs at HK$1.80/shr.
newsitem.headline: City Telecom offers 100 mln shrs at HK$1.80/shr.

text.p: Telecommunication services provider City Telecom (HK) Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 100 million new shares at HK$1.80 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.

The issue price represents a price earnings multiple of 8.22 times on a proforma fully-diluted basis and 6.95 times on a weighted average basis. The prospectus dividend yield per share is four percent.
The IPO will run from July 22 to 25 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on August 4. Citicorp International Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
City Telecom is engaged in the provision of international telecommunications services to over 230 countries and territories.

From the net proceeds of about HK$165 million, HK$30 million will be used to buy premises for the establishment of a switching centre in Hong Kong, HK$40 million to upgrade its telecommunication network, HK$10 million for research and development of new services, and the balance of HK$85 million will be used for working capital.

The company forecast profit attributable to shareholders of about HK$80 million for the year ending in August 31, 1997, up from HK$64.49 million in 1996, HK$19.46 million in 1995 and HK$13.46 million in 1994.
It had turnover of HK$500.85 million in 1996, up from HK$268.90 million in 1995, and HK$113.94 million in 1994.
